note: WEEKEND BUILD — Saturday 7/11. Markets closed since Fri 4pm ET, CME futures don't reopen until Sun 6pm ET. This is post-close review through Sat morning, not an overnight session. BTC (24/7 tape) is the only live instrument. Story: Fri finished the week strong (SPX +0.4% to 7,575.39, fourth winning week in five), DAL beat kicked off Q2 earnings season with FY26 reaffirm + dividend +15%, SK Hynix debuted +13% on Nasdaq as SKHYV ADR. Iran situation is the wild card — US issued effectively a Saturday deadline for Iran to publicly commit to Hormuz being open and attacks stopped. Muscat talks today. Sun-night futures reopen will trade off whatever comes out of that.

geo_headlines: Fri 7/10 US close: SPX +0.4% to 7,575.39 (fourth winning week in last five). DAL beat kicked off Q2 earnings season — record revenue, EPS $1.56 vs $1.49, reaffirmed FY26 $6.50-$7.50, raised dividend 15%, strong Q3 outlook (Barchart, MarketWatch)

SK Hynix (SKHYV) debuted on Nasdaq Fri as ADR — opened +14% at $170, closed +13% at $168 vs $149 IPO. Massive US investor demand for AI/HBM exposure. Kospi +2.52%, Kosdaq +5.47% (Hankyung, SETN, Sina)

US issued effectively a Saturday deadline (7/11) for Iran to publicly commit that Hormuz is open, no more attacks, no tolls. If not: 'serious consequences' — including additional military action per US officials. Iran FM Araghchi meeting Omani FM in Muscat Sat to discuss (Axios/CBS, Hankyoreh, Anadolu)
Treasury sanctioned Dubai-based Iranian financier Ali Ansari + exchange houses moving billions for sanctioned Iranian banks. Announced Fri after Iran resumed attacks (Straits Times, Reuters)

Trump on Fri: 'The Islamic Republic of Iran has asked us to continue talks. We have agreed to do so, but the United States has stated to them, in no uncertain terms, that the Cease Fire is OVER!' Vance/Rubio/Witkoff/Kushner leading talks (Straits Times, CBS)
Hormuz traffic Thu 7/9 fell to 34 ships — lowest since June 28 per S&P Global Commodities at Sea. No new attacks reported Fri. Iran-linked and sanctioned traffic still ~1/3 of crossings (CBS)
Bipartisan Senate group (Blumenthal, Graham, Shaheen, Wicker) reached agreement with Trump admin on updated Russia sanctions legislation Fri — 'expect to roll out very soon' (Straits Times)
CPI June released Tue 7/14 08:30 — consensus 3.9% YoY (Cleveland Fed nowcast 3.96%), core 2.9%. May was 4.2%. Bank Q2 kickoff same day: JPM, WFC, C, BLK BMO. BAC/MS/GS Wed
